units.zh: 睿宗顯懿莊聖皇后，名唆魯和帖尼，怯烈氏，生子憲宗、世祖，相繼為帝。
units.en: Empress Xianyi Zhuang Sheng of Emperor Ruizong Tolui was named Sorghaghtani Beki of the Kereit. She bore Möngke and Kublai, each of whom in turn became emperor.
units.literal: Empress Xianyi Zhuang Sheng of Emperor Ruizong, personal name Sorghaghtani Beki, of the Kereit clan; she bore the Xianzong Emperor and the Shizu Emperor, who succeeded one another on the throne.

units.zh: 至元二年，追上尊謚莊聖皇后，升祔睿宗廟。
units.en: In 1265 she was given the posthumous title Empress Zhuang Sheng and enshrined in Emperor Ruizong's temple.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan, the posthumous honorific title Empress Zhuang Sheng was conferred and she was installed in the temple of Emperor Ruizong.

units.zh: 至大二年十二月，加謚顯懿莊聖皇后。
units.en: In December 1309 her title was further augmented to Empress Xianyi Zhuang Sheng.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Zhida, the title was augmented to Empress Xianyi Zhuang Sheng.

units.zh: 三年十月，又上玉冊，其文曰：「祖功宗德，稱誄於天。
units.en: In the tenth month of 1310 a jade book was presented again. Its text read: "The achievements of the ancestors and the virtue of the forefathers are proclaimed in eulogy to Heaven.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, a jade book was again presented; its text read: "The achievements of the ancestors and the virtue of the forefathers are proclaimed in eulogy to Heaven.

units.zh: 內則閫儀，受成於廟。
units.en: The inner norms and the rites of the inner court receive their completion in the ancestral temple.
units.literal: The inner norms and the rites of the inner court receive their completion in the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 行之大者名必顯，恩之隆者報則豐。
units.en: Great deeds demand that a name shine forth; profound favor calls for abundant recompense.
units.literal: When great deeds are performed, the name must shine forth; when favor is profound, the recompense is abundant.

units.zh: 上以增佐定之光，下以伸遹追之孝。
units.en: Above, to add luster to the achievement of assisting in the founding; below, to extend the filial piety of distant commemoration.
units.literal: Above, to add luster to the achievement of assisting in the founding; below, to extend the filial piety of distant commemoration.

units.zh: 欽惟莊聖皇后，英明溥博，聖善柔嘉。
units.en: Reverently considering Empress Zhuang Sheng: perspicacious and broadly accomplished, sagely, good, gentle, and excellent.
units.literal: Reverently considering Empress Zhuang Sheng: perspicacious and broadly accomplished, sagely, good, gentle, and excellent.

units.zh: 尊儷景襄，陰教純被。
units.en: She honored and matched Emperor Jingxiang Tolui; the teachings of the inner court were purely diffused.
units.literal: She honored and matched Emperor Jingxiang; the teachings of the inner court were purely diffused.

units.zh: 逮事光獻，婦職勤修。
units.en: When she came to serve Empress Guangxian, she diligently cultivated the duties of a wife.
units.literal: When she came to serve Guangxian, she diligently cultivated the duties of a wife.

units.zh: 勛聿著於承天，祥兩占於夢日。
units.en: Her merit was forthwith displayed in receiving Heaven's mandate; auspicious omens of two suns were divined in a dream of the sun.
units.literal: Her merit was forthwith displayed in receiving Heaven's mandate; auspicious omens of two suns were divined in a dream of the sun.

units.zh: 跡聖緒洪源之有漸，知深仁厚澤之無垠。
units.en: Tracing the sage succession, one sees the great source unfold by degrees and knows that deep benevolence and thick grace are boundless.
units.literal: Tracing the sage succession, the great source had its gradual unfolding; knowing that deep benevolence and thick grace are boundless.

units.zh: 玄符肇自塗山，顧前徽之未稱；
units.en: The dark talisman arose from Mount Tu, yet the former excellence had not been fittingly honored;
units.literal: The dark talisman arose from Mount Tu; yet the former excellence had not been fittingly honored;

units.zh: 蒼箓興於文母，豈后嗣之能忘。
units.en: the azure register rose from the civil mother — how could posterity forget?
units.literal: the azure register rose from the civil mother — how could posterity forget?

units.zh: 是用參考彜經，丕揚景鑠。
units.en: Therefore the canonical classics were consulted and the great resplendent standard was raised high.
units.literal: Therefore the canonical classics were consulted and the great resplendent standard was raised high.

units.zh: 敷繹寶慈之誼，形容青史之規。
units.en: The meaning of precious compassion was set forth and expounded, and the model for the blue annals was given form.
units.literal: The meaning of precious compassion was set forth and expounded, and the model for the blue annals was given form.

units.zh: 謹遣攝太尉某奉玉冊玉寶，加上尊謚曰顯懿莊聖皇后。
units.en: We respectfully send the Acting Grand Commandant to present the jade book and jade seal and add the honorific posthumous title Empress Xianyi Zhuang Sheng.
units.literal: We respectfully send the Acting Grand Commandant [name] to present the jade book and jade seal and add the honorific posthumous title Empress Xianyi Zhuang Sheng.

units.zh: 伏惟睿靈，昭垂鑒格。
units.en: We humbly trust that your wise spirit will brightly descend and grant inspection and acceptance.
units.literal: We humbly trust that your wise spirit will brightly descend and grant inspection and acceptance.

units.zh: 禮嚴閟宮，樂歌夷則。
units.en: Rites were solemn in the secluded palace; music sang the yize mode.
units.literal: Rites were solemn in the secluded palace; music sang the yize mode.

units.zh: 億萬斯年，承休無斁。」
units.en: For ten thousand myriad years may blessings be received without end."
units.literal: For ten thousand myriad years may blessings be received without end."

units.zh: 裕宗徽仁裕聖皇后伯藍也怯赤，一名闊闊真，弘吉剌氏，生順宗、成宗。
units.en: Empress Huiren Yusheng of Emperor Yuzong Zhenjin was Bo'alaije'u, also called Kokejin, of the Hongjira clan. She bore Darmabala and Temür, who became Emperors Shunzong and Chengzong.
units.literal: Empress Huiren Yusheng of Emperor Yuzong, Bo'alaije'u, also called Kokejin, of the Hongjira clan; she bore the Shunzong Emperor and the Chengzong Emperor.

units.zh: 先是世祖出田獵，道渴，至一帳房，見一女子緝駝茸，世祖從覓馬湩。
units.en: Earlier, when Kublai went out hunting, he grew thirsty on the road, came to a tent, and saw a girl sewing camel hair. He asked her for kumiss.
units.literal: Earlier, when Shizu went out hunting, he grew thirsty on the road, came to a tent, and saw a girl sewing camel hair; Shizu asked her for kumiss.

units.zh: 女子曰：「馬湩有之，但我父母諸兄皆不在，我女子難以與汝。」
units.en: The girl said, "There is kumiss, but my parents and elder brothers are all away. As a girl alone I cannot easily give it to you."
units.literal: The girl said: "There is kumiss, but my parents and elder brothers are all away; as a girl alone I find it hard to give it to you."

units.zh: 世祖欲去之。
units.en: Kublai was about to leave.
units.literal: Shizu was about to leave.

units.zh: 女子又曰：「我獨居此，汝自來自去，於理不宜。
units.en: The girl said again, "I live here alone. For you to come and go by yourself is not proper.
units.literal: The girl again said: "I live here alone; for you to come and go by yourself is not proper by reason.

units.zh: 我父母即歸，姑待之。」
units.en: My parents will return shortly. Please wait."
units.literal: My parents will return at once — please wait a little."

units.zh: 須臾果歸。
units.en: In a moment they did return.
units.literal: In a moment they indeed returned.

units.zh: 出馬湩飲世祖。
units.en: They brought out kumiss for Kublai to drink.
units.literal: They brought out kumiss for Shizu to drink.

units.zh: 世祖既去，嘆息曰：「得此等女子為人家婦，豈不美耶！」
units.en: After Kublai had gone, he sighed and said, "To obtain a girl like this as a wife for one's household — would it not be fine!"
units.literal: After Shizu had gone, he sighed and said: "To obtain a girl like this as a wife for one's household — would it not be fine!"

units.zh: 后與諸臣謀擇太子妃，世祖俱不允。
units.en: Later the empress and the ministers deliberated on choosing a crown princess, but Kublai would not approve any of them.
units.literal: Later the empress and the ministers deliberated on choosing a crown princess; Shizu would not approve any of them.

units.zh: 有一老臣嘗知向者之言，知其未許嫁，言於世祖。
units.en: An old minister had once heard what Kublai had said. Knowing that the girl was not yet betrothed, he spoke of it to Kublai.
units.literal: An old minister had once heard what Shizu had said; knowing that she was not yet betrothed, he spoke of it to Shizu.

units.zh: 世祖大喜，納為太子妃。
units.en: Kublai was greatly pleased and took her in as crown princess.
units.literal: Shizu was greatly pleased and took her in as crown princess.

units.zh: 后性孝謹，善事中宮，世祖每稱之為賢德媳婦。
units.en: The consort was by nature filial and careful and good at serving the inner palace. Kublai always called her a worthy and virtuous daughter-in-law.
units.literal: The consort was by nature filial and careful, good at serving the inner palace; Shizu always called her a worthy and virtuous daughter-in-law.

units.zh: 侍昭睿順聖皇后，不離左右，至混廁所用紙，亦以面擦，令柔軟以進。
units.en: She attended Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng and never left her side. Even the paper used in the privy she rubbed with her face to soften before presenting it.
units.literal: She attended Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng and never left her side; even the paper used in the privy she rubbed with her face to make it soft before presenting it.

units.zh: 一日，裕宗有病，世祖往視，見床上設織金臥褥。
units.en: One day Zhenjin was ill. Kublai went to visit and saw a brocaded gold sleeping mat on the bed.
units.literal: One day Yuzong was ill; Shizu went to visit and saw a brocaded gold sleeping mat set on the bed.

units.zh: 世祖慍而語之曰：「我嘗以汝為賢，何乃若此耶？」
units.en: Kublai grew angry and said to her, "I once regarded you as worthy. How can you be like this?"
units.literal: Shizu grew angry and said to her: "I once regarded you as worthy — how can you be like this?"

units.zh: 后跪答曰：「常時不曾敢用，今為太子病，恐有濕氣，因用之。」
units.en: The consort knelt and answered, "At ordinary times I never dared use it. Now, because the crown prince is ill, I feared dampness and therefore used it."
units.literal: The consort knelt and answered: "At ordinary times I never dared use it; now, because the crown prince is ill, I feared dampness and therefore used it."

units.zh: 即時徹去。
units.en: She immediately had it removed.
units.literal: She immediately had it removed.

units.zh: 世祖崩，成宗至上都，諸王畢會。
units.en: When Kublai died, Temür arrived at Shangdu and all the princes assembled.
units.literal: When Shizu died, Chengzong arrived at Shangdu and all the princes assembled.

units.zh: 先是，御史中丞崔彧得玉璽於木華黎國王曾孫世德家，其文曰「受命於天，既壽永昌」，上之於后，至是，后手授成宗。
units.en: Earlier the Censor-in-Chief Cui Yu had obtained the jade seal in the home of Shide, great-grandson of Prince Muqali. Its inscription read "Receiving the mandate from Heaven, long life and eternal prosperity." He presented it to the empress, and on this occasion she personally handed it to Temür.
units.literal: Earlier, the Censor-in-Chief Cui Yu had obtained the jade seal in the home of Shide, great-grandson of Prince Muqali; its inscription read "Receiving the mandate from Heaven, long life and eternal prosperity." He presented it to the empress; at this time the empress personally handed it to Chengzong.

units.zh: 即皇帝位，尊后為皇太后，冊文曰：「自家而國，治道必有所先；
units.en: Upon assuming the imperial throne, he honored the empress as Empress Dowager. The investiture text read: "From the family to the state, the way of governance must have what comes first;
units.literal: Upon assuming the imperial throne, he honored the empress as Empress Dowager; the investiture text read: "From the family to the state, the way of governance must have what comes first;

units.zh: 立愛惟親，君德莫先於孝。
units.en: establishing love begins with kin, and among the virtues of a ruler none comes before filial piety.
units.literal: establishing love begins with kin; among the virtues of a ruler none comes before filial piety.

units.zh: 況恩深於鞠我，而禮重於正名。
units.en: How much more when favor is deep in nurturing me, and ritual weighs heavily in rectifying the name!
units.literal: How much more when favor is deep in nurturing me, and ritual weighs heavily in rectifying the name!

units.zh: 歷代以來，令儀可考。
units.en: Through successive dynasties, excellent precedents may be examined.
units.literal: Through successive dynasties, excellent precedents may be examined.

units.zh: 人子之職所在，天下之母宜尊。
units.en: Where the duty of a son lies, the mother of the realm should be honored.
units.literal: Where the duty of a son lies, the mother of the realm should be honored.

units.zh: 恭惟聖母，聖善本乎天資，靜專法乎地道。
units.en: Reverently considering the Holy Mother: sagely goodness is rooted in Heaven-given nature, and stillness and concentration follow the way of Earth.
units.literal: Reverently considering the Holy Mother: sagely goodness is rooted in Heaven-given nature; stillness and concentration follow the way of Earth.

units.zh: 上以奉宗祏之重，下以敘倫紀之常。
units.en: Above, to uphold the weight of the ancestral tablets; below, to set in order the constants of human relations.
units.literal: Above, to uphold the weight of the ancestral tablets; below, to set in order the constants of human relations.

units.zh: 助我前人，守《卷耳》憂勤之志；
units.en: She aided my forebears, keeping the anxious diligence of "Roll up your sleeves";
units.literal: She aided my forebears, keeping the anxious diligence of "Roll up your sleeves";

units.zh: 保予沖子，成《思齊》雍肅之風。
units.en: she protected my young heir and completed the harmonious solemnity of "Be like him."
units.literal: she protected my young heir and completed the harmonious solemnity of "Be like him."

units.zh: 肆神器之有歸，知孫謀之素定。
units.en: Now that the sacred vessel has its destination, we know that the grandson's design was long settled.
units.literal: Now that the sacred vessel has its destination, we know that the grandson's design was long settled.

units.zh: 畀付雖由於歷數，規摹一出於庭闈。
units.en: Though the conferral follows the sequence of fate, the plan and model issued from the inner court.
units.literal: Though the conferral follows the sequence of fate, the plan and model issued from the inner court.

units.zh: 是用率籲眾心，章明巨度，不勝拳拳大願。
units.en: Therefore we lead and call forth the hearts of the multitude, proclaim the great measure, and cannot overcome our earnest great wish.
units.literal: Therefore we lead and call forth the hearts of the multitude, proclaim the great measure, and cannot overcome our earnest great wish.

units.zh: 謹奉冊寶，上尊稱曰皇太后。
units.en: We respectfully present the book and seal and raise the honorific title Empress Dowager.
units.literal: We respectfully present the book and seal and raise the honorific title Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 伏惟長信穆穆，周宗綿綿。
units.en: We humbly trust that long faith will be solemn and the Zhou lineage unending.
units.literal: We humbly trust that long faith will be solemn and the Zhou lineage unending.

units.zh: 備《洛書》之錫福，粲慈極之儀天。
units.en: Complete with the blessings granted in the Luo Document, resplendent as the compassionate pole in honoring Heaven.
units.literal: Complete with the blessings granted in the Luo Document, resplendent as the compassionate pole in honoring Heaven.

units.zh: 瑤圖寶運，於萬斯年。」
units.en: The jade chart and precious destiny — for ten thousand years."
units.literal: The jade chart and precious destiny — for ten thousand years."

units.zh: 命設官屬，置徽政院。
units.en: He ordered officials to be appointed and established the Bureau of Imperial Governance.
units.literal: He ordered officials to be appointed and established the Bureau of Imperial Governance.

units.zh: 后院官有受獻浙西田七百頃，籍於位下，太后曰：「我寡居婦人，衣食自有餘，況江南率土，皆國家所有，我曷敢私之。」
units.en: An official of the rear palace had received as tribute seven hundred qing of land in western Zhejiang, registered under her station. The Empress Dowager said, "I am a widow living alone — food and clothing are already more than enough. Moreover, all the lands south of the Yangtze belong to the state. How dare I make them private?"
units.literal: An official of the rear palace had received as tribute seven hundred qing of land in western Zhejiang, registered under her station; the Empress Dowager said: "I am a widow living alone — food and clothing are already more than enough; moreover, all the lands south of the Yangtze belong to the state. How dare I make them private?"

units.zh: 即命中書省盡易院官之受獻者。
units.en: She immediately ordered the Secretariat to replace entirely those bureau officials who had received such tribute.
units.literal: She immediately ordered the Secretariat to replace entirely those bureau officials who had received such tribute.

units.zh: 后之弟欲因后求官，后語之曰：「若欲求官耶？
units.en: The empress's younger brother wished to seek office through her. The empress said to him, "If you wish to seek office,
units.literal: The empress's younger brother wished to seek office through her; the empress said to him: "If you wish to seek office,

units.zh: 汝自為之，勿以累我也。」
units.en: do it yourself. Do not involve me."
units.literal: do it yourself — do not involve me."

units.zh: 其后，弟果被黜，人皆服后之先見。
units.en: Afterward his younger brother was indeed dismissed, and everyone admired the empress's foresight.
units.literal: Afterward his younger brother was indeed dismissed, and everyone admired the empress's foresight.

units.zh: 大德四年二月崩，祔葬先陵，謚曰裕聖皇后，升祔裕宗廟。
units.en: In the second month of 1300 she died, was buried beside the former imperial tombs, posthumously titled Empress Yusheng, and installed in the temple of Emperor Yuzong.
units.literal: In the second month of the fourth year of Dade she died, was buried beside the former imperial tombs, posthumously titled Empress Yusheng, and installed in the temple of Emperor Yuzong.

units.zh: 至大三年十月，又追尊謚曰徽仁裕聖皇后。
units.en: In the tenth month of 1310 the title was further raised to Empress Huiren Yusheng.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Zhida, the title was further raised to Empress Huiren Yusheng.

units.zh: 顯宗宣懿淑聖皇后，名普顏怯里迷失，弘吉剌氏。
units.en: Empress Xuanyi Shusheng of Emperor Xianzong was named Buyan Qilimishi of the Hongjira clan.
units.literal: Empress Xuanyi Shusheng of Emperor Xianzong, personal name Buyan Qilimishi, of the Hongjira clan.

units.zh: 顯宗居晉邸，納為元妃，生泰定帝。
units.en: When Xianzong resided at the Jin residence, she was taken in as primary consort and bore Yesün Temür, who became Emperor Taiding.
units.literal: When Xianzong resided at the Jin residence, she was taken in as primary consort and bore the Taiding Emperor.

units.zh: 泰定元年，追尊宣懿淑聖皇后，其冊文曰：「祗纘皇圖，方弘仁孝之化；
units.en: In 1324 she was posthumously honored as Empress Xuanyi Shusheng. The investiture text read: "Reverently continuing the imperial design, broadly extending the transformation of benevolence and filial piety;
units.literal: In the first year of Taiding she was posthumously honored as Empress Xuanyi Shusheng; the text of the investiture document read: "Reverently continuing the imperial design, broadly extending the transformation of benevolence and filial piety;

units.zh: 追崇聖母，永懷鞠育之恩。
units.en: elevating the sacred mother, ever cherishing the grace of nurture.
units.literal: elevating the sacred mother, ever cherishing the grace of nurture.

units.zh: 匪建鴻名，疇彰厚德。
units.en: Without establishing a great name, how could thick virtue be displayed?
units.literal: Without establishing a great name, how could thick virtue be displayed?

units.zh: 欽惟皇妣晉王妃弘吉剌氏，淑侔周姒，賢邁虞嬪。
units.en: Reverently considering our imperial mother, Princess of Jin of the Hongjira clan: gentle as Zhou's Si, worthy beyond Yu's Bin.
units.literal: Reverently considering our imperial mother, Princess of Jin of the Hongjira clan: gentle as Zhou's Si, worthy beyond Yu's Bin.

units.zh: 儷我先王，恪守肇基之地；
units.en: She matched our former king and steadfastly kept the ground of founding;
units.literal: She matched our former king and steadfastly kept the ground of founding;

units.zh: 昭其懿範，益恢正始之風。
units.en: making her excellent model shine and further restoring the wind of the correct beginning.
units.literal: making her excellent model shine and further restoring the wind of the correct beginning.

units.zh: 順坤道以承乾，炯月輝以遡日。
units.en: Following the way of earth to receive heaven, bright as moonlight tracing back to the sun.
units.literal: Following the way of earth to receive heaven, bright as moonlight tracing back to the sun.

units.zh: 陰功久積，衍聖緒於無疆；
units.en: Hidden merit long accumulated, extending the sage succession without bound;
units.literal: Hidden merit long accumulated, extending the sage succession without bound;

units.zh: 神器攸歸，知慶源之有自。
units.en: the sacred vessel had its destined return — one knew the source of blessing had its origin.
units.literal: the sacred vessel had its destined return — one knew the source of blessing had its origin.

units.zh: 仰徽音之如在，慨至養之莫加。
units.en: Looking up to her excellent renown as though she were present, sighing that highest nurture could be no greater.
units.literal: Looking up to her excellent renown as though she were present, sighing that highest nurture could be no greater.

units.zh: 聿選休辰，爰修縟典。
units.en: Selecting an auspicious day, we now perform the full ceremony.
units.literal: Selecting an auspicious day, we now perform the full ceremony.

units.zh: 謹遣攝太尉某奉玉冊玉寶，上尊諡曰宣懿淑聖皇后。
units.en: We respectfully send the Acting Grand Commandant to present the jade book and jade seal and confer the honorific posthumous title Empress Xuanyi Shusheng.
units.literal: We respectfully send the Acting Grand Commandant to present the jade book and jade seal and confer the honorific posthumous title Empress Xuanyi Shusheng.

units.zh: 伏惟淑靈在上，式垂鑒臨，合享太宮，永錫繁祉。」
units.en: We humbly trust that your gentle spirit above will brightly descend in inspection; jointly enjoy the Great Temple and be ever granted abundant blessings."
units.literal: We humbly trust that your gentle spirit above will brightly descend in inspection; jointly enjoy the Great Temple and be ever granted abundant blessings."

units.zh: 升祔皇考顯宗廟。
units.en: She was installed in the temple of our imperial father Xianzong.
units.literal: She was installed in the temple of our imperial father Xianzong.

units.zh: 天曆初，復祧顯宗廟祀。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianli, the sacrifice at Xianzong's temple was restored.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianli, the sacrifice at Xianzong's temple was restored.

units.zh: 順宗昭獻元聖皇后，名答己，弘吉剌氏，按陳孫渾都帖木兒之女。
units.en: Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng of Emperor Shunzong Darmabala was named Daji of the Hongjira clan, daughter of Qundutemür, grandson of Anchen.
units.literal: Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng of Emperor Shunzong, personal name Daji, of the Hongjira clan, daughter of Anchen's grandson Qundutemür.

units.zh: 裕宗居燕邸及潮河，順宗俱在侍，稍長，世祖賜女侍郭氏，後乃納后為妃，生武宗及仁宗。
units.en: When Zhenjin resided at the Yan residence and at Chaohe, Darmabala was always in attendance. When he grew somewhat older, Kublai granted him the attendant Guo, and later he took Daji as consort. She bore Külüg Khan and Ayurbarwada, who became Emperors Wuzong and Renzong.
units.literal: When Yuzong resided at the Yan residence and at Chaohe, Shunzong was always in attendance; when he grew somewhat older, Shizu granted him the attendant Guo, and later he took the empress as consort; she bore the Wuzong Emperor and the Renzong Emperor.

units.zh: 大德九年，成宗不豫，卜魯罕皇后秉政，遣仁宗母子出居懷州。
units.en: In 1305 Chengzong fell ill. Empress Buluqan held power and sent Ayurbarwada and his mother out to reside at Huaizhou.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Dade, Chengzong fell ill; Empress Buluqan held power and sent the Renzong Emperor and his mother out to reside at Huaizhou.

units.zh: 十年十二月，后至懷州。
units.en: In the twelfth month of 1306 the empress arrived at Huaizhou.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the tenth year, the empress arrived at Huaizhou.

units.zh: 十一年正月，成宗崩。
units.en: In the first month of 1307 Chengzong died.
units.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year, Chengzong died.

units.zh: 時武宗總兵北邊，右丞相答剌罕哈剌哈孫陰遣使報仁宗，與后奔還京師。
units.en: At that time Külüg Khan commanded troops on the northern frontier. The Right Chancellor Daraqan Qaraqas secretly sent envoys to inform Ayurbarwada, and the empress and he rushed back to the capital.
units.literal: At that time Wuzong commanded troops on the northern frontier; the Right Chancellor Daraqan Qaraqas secretly sent envoys to inform Renzong, and the empress and he rushed back to the capital.

units.zh: 后與仁宗入內哭，復出居舊邸，朝夕入奠。
units.en: The empress and Ayurbarwada entered the palace to weep, then returned to their former residence, morning and evening entering to offer libations.
units.literal: The empress and Renzong entered within to weep, then went out again to reside at their former residence, morning and evening entering to offer libations.

units.zh: 即遣使迎武宗還，以五月即位。
units.en: They immediately sent envoys to welcome Külüg Khan back, and in the fifth month he took the throne.
units.literal: They immediately sent envoys to welcome Wuzong back; in the fifth month he took the throne.

units.zh: 先是，太后以兩太子星命付陰陽家推算，問所宜立，對曰：「重光大荒落有災，旃蒙作噩長久。」
units.en: Earlier the Empress Dowager had given the nativities of the two crown princes to yin-yang masters to calculate and asked which should be established. They answered, "Chongguang and Dahuangluo have calamity; Zhanmeng and Zuo'e are long-lasting."
units.literal: Earlier, the Empress Dowager had given the nativities of the two crown princes to yin-yang masters to calculate and asked which should be established; they answered: "Chongguang and Dahuangluo have calamity; Zhanmeng and Zuo'e are long-lasting."

units.zh: 重光為武宗生年，旃蒙為仁宗生年。
units.en: Chongguang was Külüg Khan's birth year; Zhanmeng was Ayurbarwada's birth year.
units.literal: Chongguang was Wuzong's birth year; Zhanmeng was Renzong's birth year.

units.zh: 太后頗惑其言，遣近臣朵耳諭旨武宗曰：「汝兄弟二人，皆我所出，豈有親疏。
units.en: The Empress Dowager was rather swayed by their words and sent a close attendant, Dor, to convey her instruction to Külüg Khan: "You two brothers were both born of me. How could there be closeness or distance?
units.literal: The Empress Dowager was rather swayed by their words and sent a close attendant, Dor, to convey her instruction to Wuzong: "You two brothers were both born of me — how could there be closeness or distance?

units.zh: 陰陽家所言，運祚修短，不容不思也。」
units.en: What the yin-yang masters say about the length of fortune and fate — one cannot fail to consider it."
units.literal: What the yin-yang masters say about the length of fortune and fate — one cannot fail to consider it."

units.zh: 武宗聞之默然，進康裏脫脫而言曰：「我捍北邊十年，又胤次居長，太后以星命為言，茫昧難信。
units.en: Külüg Khan heard this and was silent. He advanced Kangli Toqto'a and said, "I have defended the northern frontier for ten years, and by birth order I am the elder. The Empress Dowager speaks of star-fate — it is obscure and hard to trust.
units.literal: Wuzong heard this and was silent; he advanced Kangli Toqto'a and said: "I have defended the northern frontier for ten years, and by birth order I am the elder. The Empress Dowager speaks of star-fate — it is obscure and hard to trust.

units.zh: 使我設施合於天心民望，雖一日之短，亦足垂名萬世。
units.en: If my measures accord with Heaven's mind and the people's hopes, even a reign of one day would be enough to leave a name for ten thousand generations.
units.literal: If my measures accord with Heaven's mind and the people's hopes, even a reign of one day would be enough to leave a name for ten thousand generations.

units.zh: 何可以陰陽家言，而乖祖宗之托哉！」
units.en: How can one go against the charge of the ancestors because of what yin-yang masters say!"
units.literal: How can one go against the charge of the ancestors because of what yin-yang masters say!"

units.zh: 脫脫以聞，太后愕然曰：「修短之說，雖出術家，吾為太子遠慮，所以深愛太子也。
units.en: Toqto'a reported this. The Empress Dowager was startled and said, "The talk of long and short reigns, though it comes from specialists, is my far-sighted concern for the crown prince. That is why I deeply love the crown prince.
units.literal: Toqto'a reported this; the Empress Dowager was startled and said: "The talk of long and short reigns, though it comes from specialists, is my far-sighted concern for the crown prince — that is why I deeply love the crown prince.

units.zh: 太子既如是言，今當速來耳。」
units.en: Since the crown prince has spoken thus, he should come quickly now."
units.literal: Since the crown prince has spoken thus, he should come quickly now."

units.zh: 詳見《康里脫脫傳》中。
units.en: For details see the biography of Kangli Toqto'a.
units.literal: For details see the biography of Kangli Toqto'a.

units.zh: 五月，武宗既立，即日尊太后為皇太后。
units.en: In the fifth month, after Külüg Khan had been established, that same day he honored the Empress Dowager as Empress Dowager.
units.literal: In the fifth month, after Wuzong had been established, that same day he honored the Empress Dowager as Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 立仁宗為皇太子。
units.en: He established Ayurbarwada as crown prince.
units.literal: He established Renzong as crown prince.

units.zh: 三宮協和。
units.en: The three palaces were in harmony.
units.literal: The three palaces were in harmony.

units.zh: 十一月，帝朝太后於隆福宮，上皇太后玉冊玉寶。
units.en: In the eleventh month the emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager at Longfu Palace and presented the jade book and jade seal of Empress Dowager.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, the emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager at Longfu Palace and presented the jade book and jade seal of Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 至大元年三月，帝為太后建興聖宮，給鈔五萬錠、絲二萬斤。
units.en: In the third month of 1308 the emperor built the Palace of Sagely Inception for the Empress Dowager and granted fifty thousand ingots of paper money and twenty thousand jin of silk.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Zhida, the emperor built the Palace of Sagely Inception for the Empress Dowager and granted fifty thousand ingots of paper money and twenty thousand jin of silk.

units.zh: 二年正月，太后幸五臺山作佛事，詔高麗王璋從之。
units.en: In the first month of 1309 the Empress Dowager visited Mount Wutai to perform Buddhist rites. An edict ordered King Ch'ang of Goryeo to accompany her.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year, the Empress Dowager visited Mount Wutai to perform Buddhist rites; an edict ordered King Ch'ang of Goryeo to accompany her.

units.zh: 四月，立興聖宮江淮財賦總管府，以司太后錢糧。
units.en: In the fourth month the General Directorate of Revenue for the Jiang-Huai Circuit of the Palace of Sagely Inception was established to administer the Empress Dowager's funds and grain.
units.literal: In the fourth month, the General Directorate of Revenue for the Jiang-Huai Circuit of the Palace of Sagely Inception was established to administer the Empress Dowager's funds and grain.

units.zh: 三年二月，以上皇太后尊號，告祀南郊。
units.en: In the second month of 1310, because of the honorific title of Empress Dowager, announcement was made at the southern suburban sacrifice.
units.literal: In the second month of the third year, because of the honorific title of Empress Dowager, announcement was made at the southern suburban sacrifice.

units.zh: 四月，以興聖宮鷹坊等戶四千，分處遼陽，建萬戶府統之。
units.en: In the fourth month four thousand households of the falconry office and the like of the Palace of Sagely Inception were distributed to Liaoyang, and a myriarchate office was established to govern them.
units.literal: In the fourth month, four thousand households of the falconry office and the like of the Palace of Sagely Inception were distributed to Liaoyang, and a myriarchate office was established to govern them.

units.zh: 十月戊申，帝率皇太子諸王群臣朝興聖宮，上皇太后尊號冊寶曰儀天興聖慈仁昭懿壽元皇太后。
units.en: On the wushen day of the tenth month the emperor led the crown prince, princes, and ministers to attend at the Palace of Sagely Inception and presented the honorific book and seal: Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan.
units.literal: On the wushen day of the tenth month, the emperor led the crown prince, princes, and ministers to attend at the Palace of Sagely Inception and presented the honorific book and seal: Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan.

units.zh: 庚戌，后恭謝太廟，以皇太后受尊號，詔赦天下。
units.en: On the gengxu day the empress reverently thanked the Grand Temple. Because the Empress Dowager had received the honorific title, an edict amnestied the realm.
units.literal: On the gengxu day, the empress reverently thanked the Grand Temple; because the Empress Dowager had received the honorific title, an edict amnestied the realm.

units.zh: 四年，仁宗即位。
units.en: In 1311 Ayurbarwada took the throne.
units.literal: In the fourth year, Renzong took the throne.

units.zh: 延祐二年三月，帝率諸王百官奉玉冊玉寶，加上皇太后尊號曰儀天興聖慈仁昭懿壽元全德泰寧福慶皇太后。
units.en: In the third month of 1315 the emperor led the princes and officials to present the jade book and jade seal and add the honorific title Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing.
units.literal: In the third month of the second year of Yanyou, the emperor led the princes and officials to present the jade book and jade seal and add the honorific title Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing.

units.zh: 延祐七年，英宗即位，十二月，上尊號太皇太后，冊文云：「王政之先，無以加孝，人倫之本，莫大尊親。
units.en: In 1320 Yingzong took the throne. In the twelfth month he raised the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager. The investiture text read: "Before royal government, nothing surpasses filial piety; in the root of human relations, nothing is greater than honoring kin.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Yanyou, Yingzong took the throne; in the twelfth month he raised the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager; the investiture text read: "Before royal government, nothing surpasses filial piety; in the root of human relations, nothing is greater than honoring kin.

units.zh: 肆予臨御之初，首舉推崇之典。
units.en: Now at the beginning of my assuming rule, I first perform the ceremony of exaltation.
units.literal: Now at the beginning of my assuming rule, I first perform the ceremony of exaltation.

units.zh: 恭惟太皇太后陛下，仁施溥博，明燭幽之微。
units.en: Reverently considering Her Majesty the Grand Empress Dowager: benevolence is broadly diffused, and illumination reaches the subtlest hidden things.
units.literal: Reverently considering Her Majesty the Grand Empress Dowager: benevolence is broadly diffused, and illumination reaches the subtlest hidden things.

units.zh: 爰自居淵潛之宮，已有母天下之望。
units.en: From the time she dwelt in the deep-hidden palace, she already had the expectation of mothering the realm.
units.literal: From the time she dwelt in the deep-hidden palace, she already had the expectation of mothering the realm.

units.zh: 方武宗之北狩，適成廟之賓天。
units.en: Just as Külüg Khan was hunting in the north, Chengzong became a guest of Heaven.
units.literal: Just as Wuzong was hunting in the north, it happened that Chengzong became a guest of Heaven.

units.zh: 旋克振於乾綱，諒再安於宗祏。
units.en: Soon the Heavenly regency was restored and the ancestral tablets were again secured.
units.literal: Soon the Heavenly regency was restored; surely the ancestral tablets were again secured.

units.zh: 雖有在躬之歷數，實司創業之艱難。
units.en: Though the sequence of fate rested in one's person, in truth she managed the hardships of founding.
units.literal: Though the sequence of fate rested in one's person, in truth she managed the hardships of founding.

units.zh: 儀式表於慈闈，動協謀於先帝。
units.en: Rites and forms were displayed in the compassionate quarter, and every movement accorded with the former emperor's plans.
units.literal: Rites and forms were displayed in the compassionate quarter; every movement accorded with the former emperor's plans.

units.zh: 莫究補天之妙，允如扶日之升。
units.en: Who can fathom the wonder of mending Heaven? Truly it was like supporting the sun as it rises.
units.literal: Who can fathom the wonder of mending Heaven? Truly it was like supporting the sun as it rises.

units.zh: 位履至尊，兩翼成於聖子；
units.en: Ascending to utmost honor, the two wings were formed by sage sons;
units.literal: Ascending to utmost honor, the two wings were formed by sage sons;

units.zh: 嗣登大寶，復擁佑於眇躬。
units.en: succeeding to the great treasure, again she embraced and aided my slight person.
units.literal: succeeding to the great treasure, again she embraced and aided my slight person.

units.zh: 矧德邁塗山，功高文母。
units.en: Moreover, her virtue surpasses Mount Tu and her achievement is higher than the civil mother.
units.literal: Moreover, her virtue surpasses Mount Tu and her achievement is higher than the civil mother.

units.zh: 是宜加於四字，式益衍於徽稱。
units.en: Therefore four characters should be added to further extend the emblazoned title.
units.literal: Therefore four characters should be added to further extend the emblazoned title.

units.zh: 謹奉玉冊玉寶，加上尊號曰儀天興聖慈仁昭懿壽元全德泰寧福慶徽文崇佑太皇太后。
units.en: We respectfully present the jade book and jade seal and add the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing Huiwen Chongyou.
units.literal: We respectfully present the jade book and jade seal and add the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing Huiwen Chongyou.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 茲雖涉於強名，庶庸申於善頌。
units.en: Though this touches upon forced naming, perhaps it can express fine praise.
units.literal: Though this touches upon forced naming, perhaps it can express fine praise.

units.zh: 九州四海，養未足於孝心；
units.en: The nine provinces and four seas — nurturing is not enough for filial heart;
units.literal: The nine provinces and four seas — nurturing is not enough for filial heart;

units.zh: 萬歲千秋，願永膺於壽祉。」
units.en: ten thousand years and a thousand autumns — may blessings of longevity be forever received."
units.literal: ten thousand years and a thousand autumns — may blessings of longevity be forever received."

units.zh: 丙辰，太后禦大明殿，受朝賀。
units.en: On the bingchen day the Empress Dowager held court at Daming Hall and received congratulations.
units.literal: On the bingchen day, the Empress Dowager held court at Daming Hall and received congratulations.

units.zh: 戊辰，告太廟。
units.en: On the wuchen day announcement was made at the Grand Temple.
units.literal: On the wuchen day, announcement was made at the Grand Temple.

units.zh: 太后見明宗少時有英氣，而英宗稍柔懦，諸群小以立明宗必不利於己，遂擁立英宗。
units.en: The Empress Dowager saw that in youth Mingzong had heroic spirit, while Yingzong was somewhat soft and timid. Various petty men thought that establishing Mingzong would certainly be unfavorable to themselves and therefore supported Yingzong.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager saw that in youth Mingzong had heroic spirit, while Yingzong was somewhat soft and timid; various petty men thought that establishing Mingzong would certainly be unfavorable to themselves, and therefore supported Yingzong.

units.zh: 及既即位，太后來賀，英宗即毅然見於色，后退而悔曰：「我不擬養此兒耶！」
units.en: When he had taken the throne, the Empress Dowager came to congratulate. Yingzong immediately showed it firmly in his expression. The empress withdrew and regretted, saying, "Did I not intend to raise this child!"
units.literal: When he had taken the throne, the Empress Dowager came to congratulate; Yingzong immediately showed it firmly in his expression. The empress withdrew and regretted, saying: "Did I not intend to raise this child!"

units.zh: 遂飲恨成疾。
units.en: She then drank resentment and fell ill.
units.literal: She then drank resentment and fell ill.

units.zh: 至治三年二月崩，升祔順宗廟配食。
units.en: In the second month of 1323 she died and was installed in the temple of Emperor Shunzong for joint offerings.
units.literal: In the second month of the third year of Zhizhi she died and was installed in the temple of Emperor Shunzong for joint offerings.

units.zh: 后性聰慧，歷佐三朝，教宮中侍女皆執治女功，親操井臼。
units.en: The empress was intelligent by nature. She assisted three reigns, taught all the palace maids to practice women's work, and personally handled mortar and pestle.
units.literal: The empress was intelligent by nature; she assisted three reigns, taught all the palace maids to practice women's work, and personally handled mortar and pestle.

units.zh: 然不事檢飭，自正位東朝，淫恣益甚，內則黑驢母亦烈失八用事，外則幸臣失烈門、紐鄰及時宰叠木帖兒相率為奸，以至箠辱平章張珪等，濁亂朝政，無所不至。
units.en: Yet she did not restrain herself. From establishing her position in the Eastern Court, debauchery grew ever worse. Within, Heilümu and Yilieshiba held power; without, favorites Shiliesmen and Niulin and the chief minister Timur led one another in wickedness, even to beating the Pingzhang Zhang Gui and others — corrupting government affairs without limit.
units.literal: Yet she did not restrain herself; from establishing her position in the Eastern Court, debauchery grew ever worse. Within, Heilümu and Yilieshiba held power; without, favorites Shiliesmen and Niulin and the chief minister Timur led one another in wickedness, even to beating the Pingzhang Zhang Gui and others — corrupting government affairs without limit.

units.zh: 及英宗立，群幸伏誅，而后勢焰頓息焉。
units.en: When Yingzong was established, the group of favorites were executed, and thereafter her power suddenly ceased.
units.literal: When Yingzong was established, the group of favorites were executed, and thereafter her power and flame suddenly ceased.

units.zh: 皇弟拖雷來見。
units.en: His brother Tolui came to pay his respects.
units.literal: His imperial brother Tolui came to see him.

units.zh: 是春，帝與拖雷獵於斡兒寒河，遂遣兵圍京兆。
units.en: That spring the Emperor hunted with Tolui on the Onon River, then sent troops to besiege Jingzhao.
units.literal: That spring the Emperor hunted with Tolui on the Onon River, then sent troops to besiege Jingzhao.

units.zh: 秋月，帝自將南伐，皇弟拖雷、皇侄蒙哥率師從，拔天成等堡，遂渡河攻鳳翔。
units.en: In autumn the Emperor personally led a southern campaign, with his brother Tolui and his nephew Möngke following at the head of their armies. They took Tiancheng and other forts, crossed the river, and attacked Fengxiang.
units.literal: In autumn the Emperor personally led a southern campaign; his imperial brother Tolui and imperial nephew Möngke led armies following him. They took Tiancheng and other forts, crossed the river, and attacked Fengxiang.

units.zh: 九月，拖雷薨，帝還龍庭。
units.en: In the ninth month Tolui died, and the Emperor returned to court.
units.literal: In the ninth month Tolui died; the Emperor returned to the imperial court.

units.zh: 命拖雷出師寶雞。
units.en: Tolui was ordered to lead an army out from Baoji.
units.literal: Tolui was ordered to lead an expedition from Baoji.

units.zh: 是日，拖雷及金師戰於鈞州之三峰，大敗之，獲金將蒲阿。
units.en: That day Tolui fought the Jin army at Sanfeng in Junzhou and routed them utterly, capturing the Jin general Pu'a.
units.literal: That day Tolui fought the Jin army at Sanfeng in Junzhou and routed them utterly, capturing the Jin general Pu'a.

units.zh: 王薨後十年，仁宗即位，謚王獻武。
units.en: Ten years after the prince's death Renzong took the throne and posthumously styled the prince Xianwu.
units.literal: Ten years after the prince's death Renzong took the throne and posthumously styled the prince Xianwu.

units.zh: 曰愛育黎拔力八達，是為仁宗。
units.en: and Ayurbarwada, who became Renzong.
units.literal: and Ayurbarwada, who became Renzong.

units.zh: 妃所生者曰海山，是為武宗；
units.en: Those born of the consort were Haishan, who became Wuzong;
units.literal: those born of the consort were Haishan, who became Wuzong;

units.zh: 至順元年，以籍沒張珪家田四百頃，賜護聖寺為永業。
units.en: In Zhishun 1 four hundred qing of fields confiscated from Zhang Gui's household were granted to the Husheng Temple as perpetual property.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhishun four hundred qing of fields confiscated from Zhang Gui's household were granted to the Husheng Temple as perpetual property.

units.zh: 遂改更庶政：命皇弟忽必烈領治蒙古、漢地民戶；
units.en: He then reorganized the government: his brother Kublai was put in charge of Mongol and Han households;
units.literal: He then reformed the government at large: he ordered his imperial brother Kublai to administer the Mongol and Han households;

units.zh: 秋七月，命忽必烈征大理，諸王禿兒花、撒立征身毒，怯的不花征沒裏奚，旭烈征西域素丹諸國。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn Kublai was ordered against Dali; Princes Törel and Sali against Sind; Qutuq Buqa against the Merkit; and Hulagu against the sultanates of the west.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Kublai was ordered to campaign against Dali; the princes Törel and Sali against Sind; Qutuq Buqa against the Merkit; and Hulagu against the sultanates of the Western Regions.

units.zh: 八月，忽必烈次臨洮，命總帥汪田哥以城利州聞，欲為取蜀之計。
units.en: In the eighth month Kublai halted at Lintao and ordered the commander Wang Tiange to hold Lizhou as the first step toward taking Shu.
units.literal: In the eighth month Kublai halted at Lintao and ordered the commander Wang Tiange to hold Lizhou, intending this as the opening move for taking Shu.

units.zh: 九月，忽必烈次忒剌地，分兵三道以進。
units.en: In the ninth month Kublai halted at Tere and divided his force into three columns for the advance.
units.literal: In the ninth month Kublai halted at Tere and divided his army into three columns to advance.

units.zh: 忽必烈還自大理，留兀良合台攻諸夷之未附者，入覲於獵所。
units.en: Kublai returned from Dali, left Uriyangqadai to subdue the tribes still holding out, and came to the hunt to pay homage.
units.literal: Kublai returned from Dali, leaving Uriyangqadai to attack the unsubdued tribes and coming himself to the hunt to pay homage.

units.zh: 忽必烈遣沒兒合石詣行在所，奏請續簽內郡漢軍，從之。
units.en: Kublai dispatched Mör-gechi to the mobile court to ask for further conscription of Han troops from the interior circuits, and the petition was approved.
units.literal: Kublai sent Mör-gechi to the imperial camp to petition for conscripting more Han troops from the interior circuits; the request was granted.

units.zh: 忽必烈及諸王阿裏不哥、八里土、出木哈兒、玉龍塔失、昔烈吉、公主脫滅幹等來迎，大燕，既而各遣歸所部。
units.en: Kublai and the princes Ariq Böke, Bari-tu, Chumqar, Yulutas, and Siregi, together with Princess Tuomiegan, came out to meet him. A great feast was held, and afterward each was sent home to his domain.
units.literal: Kublai and the princes Ariq Böke, Bari-tu, Chumqar, Yulutas, Siregi, and Princess Tuomiegan came to meet him; a great banquet was held, and afterward each was sent back to his appanage.

units.zh: 命張柔從忽必烈征鄂，趨杭州。
units.en: Zhang Rou was ordered to march with Kublai against Ezhou and drive toward Hangzhou.
units.literal: Zhang Rou was ordered to follow Kublai in the campaign against Ezhou, pressing toward Hangzhou.

units.zh: 命忽必烈統諸路蒙古、漢軍伐宋。
units.en: Kublai was ordered to take command of the Mongol and Han armies of every circuit for the war against the Song.
units.literal: Kublai was ordered to command the Mongol and Han armies of all circuits in the campaign against the Song.

units.zh: 元年辛亥夏六月，西方諸王別兒哥、脫哈帖木兒，東方諸王也古、脫忽、亦孫哥、按只帶、塔察兒、別裏古帶，西方諸大將班裏赤等，東方諸大將也速不花等，復大會於闊帖兀阿闌之地，共推帝即皇帝位於斡難河。
units.en: In the first year (xinhai), in the sixth month of summer, the western princes Berke and Toghtamur, the eastern princes Yeke, Toghu, Yissüngge, Ajai, Tachar, and Belgütei, the western generals led by Barchin, and the eastern generals led by Yesu Buqa met again at Kötö'ü Adal and together enthroned him on the Onon River.
units.literal: In the first year, xinhai, summer, sixth month: the western princes Berke and Toghtamur; the eastern princes Yeke, Toghu, Yissüngge, Ajai, Tachar, and Belgütei; the western generals, including Barchin; and the eastern generals, including Yesu Buqa, met again at Kötö'ü Adal and together raised the Emperor to the throne on the Onon River.

units.zh: 二年壬子春正月，幸失灰之地，遣乞都不花攻末來吉兒都怯寨。
units.en: In the second year (renzi), in the first month of spring, he visited Shihui and sent Qutuq Buqa to attack the fortress of Mergen.
units.literal: In the second year, renzi, spring, first month, the Emperor visited Shihui; Qutuq Buqa was sent to attack the fortress of Mergen.

units.zh: 三年癸丑春正月，汪田哥修治利州，且屯田，蜀人莫敢侵軼。
units.en: In the third year (guichou), in the first month of spring, Wang Tiange repaired Lizhou and opened garrison farms; the people of Shu did not dare raid across the border.
units.literal: In the third year, guichou, spring, first month, Wang Tiange repaired Lizhou and opened fields for garrison farming; the people of Shu did not dare encroach.

units.zh: 四年甲寅春，帝獵于怯蹇叉罕。
units.en: In the fourth year (jiayin), in spring, the Emperor hunted at Qeqen Chaqan.
units.literal: In the fourth year, jiayin, spring, the Emperor hunted at Qeqen Chaqan.

units.zh: 冬，大獵于也滅干哈里叉海之地。
units.en: In winter a great hunt was held at Yemüqan Qariqai.
units.literal: In winter a great hunt was held at Yemüqan Qariqai.

units.zh: 六年丙辰春，大風起北方，砂礫飛揚，白日晦冥。
units.en: In the spring of the sixth year (bingchen) a gale blew out of the north, sand and gravel whirling until broad daylight went dim.
units.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, bingchen, a great wind rose from the north; sand and gravel flew about, and the bright day turned dark.

units.zh: 七年丁巳春，幸忽闌也兒吉。
units.en: In the spring of the seventh year (dingsi) he went to Hulan-yierji.
units.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, dingsi, he visited Hulan-yierji.

units.zh: 冬，帝度漠南，至於玉龍棧。
units.en: That winter the Emperor crossed south of the desert and reached Yulongzhan.
units.literal: In winter the Emperor crossed south of the desert as far as Yulongzhan.

units.zh: 八年戊午春正月朔，幸也裏本朵哈之地，受朝賀。
units.en: On New Year's Day in the spring of the eighth year (wuwu) he went to Yilibenduoha and received the court's congratulations.
units.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring in the eighth year, wuwu, he visited Yilibenduoha and received court congratulations.

units.zh: 二月，陳日煚傳國于長子光昺。
units.en: In the second month Trần Thái Tông abdicated in favor of his eldest son Quang Hựu.
units.literal: In the second month Trần Thái Tông passed the realm to his eldest son Quang Hựu.

units.zh: 十一月己酉，帝督軍先攻鵝頂堡。
units.en: On jiyou day in the eleventh month the Emperor took command in person and opened the assault on Eding Fort.
units.literal: On jiyou day in the eleventh month the Emperor personally directed the army, first attacking Eding Fort.

units.zh: 裕宗
units.en: Yuzong (Zhenjin)
units.literal: Yuzong.

units.zh: 伯藍也怯赤妃子 （弘吉列氏。至元三十一年尊為皇太后，大德四年崩，諡曰徽仁裕聖皇后。） 安真迷失妃子
units.en: Consort Bolan Yeqiechi (Kongirat; honored as Empress Dowager in 1294; died in 1300 and was posthumously titled Empress Huiren Yusheng). Consort Anzhenmishi.
units.literal: Consort Bolan Yeqiechi (Kongirat clan; in the thirty-first year of Zhiyuan honored as Empress Dowager; died in the fourth year of Dade, posthumous title Empress Huiren Yusheng). Consort Anzhenmishi.

units.zh: 遣諸王拔都及皇子貴由、皇侄蒙哥征西域，皇子闊端征秦、鞏，皇子曲出及胡土虎伐宋，唐古征高麗。
units.en: Prince Batu, Prince Güyük, and the imperial nephew Möngke were sent to campaign in the Western Regions; Prince Köten against Qin and Gong; Prince Kölü and Hutuhu against Song; and Tangu against Goryeo.
units.literal: The prince Batu, Prince Güyük, and imperial nephew Möngke were sent to campaign in the Western Regions; Prince Köten against Qin and Gong; Prince Kölü and Hutuhu against Song; Tangu against Goryeo.

units.zh: 蒙哥征欽察部，破之，擒其酋八赤蠻。
units.en: Möngke marched against the Qipchaq tribes, broke them, and took their chieftain Bachman prisoner.
units.literal: Möngke campaigned against the Qipchaq tribes, defeated them, and captured their chieftain Bachman.

units.zh: 冬十一月，蒙哥率師圍阿速蔑怯思城，閱三月，拔之。
units.en: That winter, in the eleventh month, Möngke invested the As fortress of Miqiasi and, after three months, took it.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Möngke led troops to besiege the As fortress of Miqiasi; after three months it was taken.

units.zh: 又從諸王拔都西征，次阿速境，攻圍木柵山寨，以三十餘人與戰，帝及憲宗與焉。
units.en: He also marched with Batu on the western campaign. In As territory he invested a palisaded mountain fort and, with little more than thirty men, went into the fight — Güyük and Möngke were both there.
units.literal: He also followed the princes under Batu on the western campaign; halting in As territory, he attacked and besieged a palisaded mountain stronghold; with a little more than thirty men he joined battle — the Emperor and Möngke were among them.

units.zh: 至治三年八月癸亥，御史大夫鐵失等弒英宗，晉王也孫鐵木兒自立為皇帝，改元泰定。
units.en: Third year of Zhizhi, eighth month, on guihai day, Censor-in-Chief Tieshi and others assassinated Shidebala; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.
units.literal: Third year of Zhizhi, eighth month, on guihai day, Censor-in-Chief Tieshi and others assassinated Shidebala; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.

units.zh: 歲戊辰七月庚午，泰定皇帝崩於上都，倒剌沙專權自用，逾月不立君，朝野疑懼。
units.en: Year wuchen, seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu; Doresh monopolized power and acted on his own authority; for more than a month no ruler was installed, and court and countryside were anxious and fearful.
units.literal: Year wuchen, seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu; Doresh monopolized power and acted on his own authority; for more than a month no ruler was installed, and court and countryside were anxious and fearful.

units.zh: 時倒剌沙在上都，立泰定皇帝子為皇帝，乃遣兵分道犯大都，而梁王王禪、右丞相答失鐵木兒、御史大夫紐澤、太尉不花等兵皆次於榆林，燕帖木兒與其弟撒敦、子唐其勢等，帥師與戰，屢敗之。
units.en: At that time Doresh was at Shangdu; he installed Emperor Taiding's son as emperor and dispatched troops in separate columns to attack Dadu; meanwhile Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, censor-in-chief Niudze, and grand marshal Buqa all encamped their armies at Yulin; Yan Temür with his younger brother Sadun, his son Tangqishi, and others commanded troops to give battle and repeatedly defeated them.
units.literal: At that time Doresh was at Shangdu; he installed Emperor Taiding's son as emperor and dispatched troops in separate columns to attack Dadu; meanwhile Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, censor-in-chief Niudze, and grand marshal Buqa all encamped their armies at Yulin; Yan Temür with his younger brother Sadun, his son Tangqishi, and others commanded troops to give battle and repeatedly defeated them.

units.zh: 順宗
units.en: Shunzong (Darmabala)
units.literal: Shunzong.

units.zh: 初，武宗有子二人，長明宗，次文宗。
units.en: Earlier, Wuzong had two sons — the elder Mingzong, the younger Wenzong.
units.literal: Earlier, Wuzong had two sons — the elder Mingzong, the younger Wenzong.

units.zh: 十一月己巳，詔翰林國史，集賢院、奎章閣學士院集議先皇帝廟號、神主、升祔武宗皇后及改元事。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the jisi day, an edict ordered the Hanlin National History Office, the Academy of Gathered Worthies, and the Kui Zhang Academy to assemble and deliberate on the late emperor's temple name, spirit tablet, elevation of Wuzong's empress to joint worship, and changing the era name.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on jisi day, an edict ordered the Hanlin National History Office, the Academy of Gathered Worthies, and the Kui Zhang Academy to assemble and deliberate on the late emperor's temple name, spirit tablet, elevation of Empress Wuzong to joint worship, and changing the era name.

units.zh: 我曲律皇帝入纂大統，修舉庶政，動合成法，授大寶位於普顏篤皇帝以及格堅皇帝。
units.en: Our Emperor Qutuqtu entered to succeed to the Great Foundation, repaired and raised all government affairs, and in action conformed to law; he bestowed the Great Treasure upon Emperors Buyan Toq and Gegegen.
units.literal: Our Emperor Qutuqtu entered to succeed to the Great Foundation, repaired and raised all government affairs, and in action conformed to law; he bestowed the Great Treasure upon Emperors Buyan Toq and Gegegen.

units.zh: 延祐中，明宗封周王，出居朔漠。
units.en: During Yanyou, Mingzong was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and went out to dwell in the northern desert.
units.literal: During Yanyou, Mingzong was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and went out to dwell in the northern desert.

units.zh: 普顏怯里迷失妃子 （泰定元年追尊諡曰宣懿淑聖皇后。） 拜拜海妃子 忽上海妃子
units.en: Consort Puyan Qilimishi (posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi Shusheng in 1324). Consort Baibaihai. Consort Hushanghai.
units.literal: Consort Puyan Qilimishi (in the first year of Taiding posthumously honored with title Empress Xuanyi Shusheng). Consort Baibaihai. Consort Hushanghai.

units.zh: 於是成宗即帝位，而晉王復歸藩邸。
units.en: Chengzong then took the throne, and the Jin Prince returned to his princely residence.
units.literal: Thereupon Chengzong took the imperial throne, and the Jin Prince returned to his princely residence.

units.zh: 五年，成宗以邊士貧乏，分給鈔一千萬貫。
units.en: In the fifth year Chengzong, because frontier troops were poor and lacking, distributed ten million strings of paper money.
units.literal: In the fifth year Chengzong, because frontier soldiers were poor and lacking, distributed ten million strings of paper money.

units.zh: 母弟鐵木耳仁孝，宜嗣大統。」
units.en: My younger brother by the same mother, Temür, is benevolent and filial and ought to succeed to the throne."
units.literal: My younger brother by the same mother, Temür, is benevolent and filial and ought to succeed to the great succession."

units.zh: 內史言於王，王曰：「惟天子所命。」
units.en: The Inner Scribe spoke to the prince. The prince said, "Only what the Son of Heaven commands."
units.literal: The Inner Scribe spoke to the prince; the prince said, "Only what the Son of Heaven commands."

units.zh: 元初，以太師、太傅、太保為三公，自木華黎國王始為太師，後凡為三公者，皆國之元勳，而漢人則惟劉秉忠嘗為太保，其後鮮有聞矣。
units.en: Early in the Yuan dynasty the Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Guardian constituted the Three Excellencies. Muqali, enfeoffed as king, was the first Grand Preceptor; thereafter every man raised to these three posts was a founding pillar of the realm. Among Han officials only Liu Bingzhong ever held Grand Guardian — and scarcely anyone among the Han after him.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Yuan, the Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Guardian were made the Three Ducal Ministers. Starting from King Muqali as Grand Preceptor, thereafter all who became the Three Ducal Ministers were founding meritorious officials of the state; among Han Chinese only Liu Bingzhong once served as Grand Guardian — after that few are heard of.

units.zh: 今固不得而悉著之，惟自木華黎而下，得拜三公者若干人，作三公表。
units.en: A full record of every holder is impossible here; this table lists only those from Muqali onward who were appointed to the three great offices.
units.literal: Now they cannot all be fully recorded; only from Muqali downward, the several men who received appointment as the Three Ducal Ministers are set forth in the Table of the Three Ducal Ministers.

units.zh: 太祖皇帝
units.en: Emperor Taizu
units.literal: Emperor Taizu

units.zh: 武宗崩，仁宗立，延祐三年春，議建東宮，時丞相鐵木叠而欲固位取寵，乃議立英宗為皇太子，又與太后幸臣識烈門譖帝於兩宮，浸潤久之，其計遂行。
units.en: Wuzong died; Renzong ascended the throne; spring of the third year of Yanyou, when the Eastern Palace was under deliberation, Chancellor Tiemudie'er, wishing to secure his position and win favor, proposed installing Shidebala as crown prince; together with the empress dowager's favorite minister Shiliemen he slandered him before the two palaces; after long insinuation, the scheme succeeded.
units.literal: Wuzong died; Renzong ascended the throne; spring of the third year of YanYou, when the Eastern Palace was under deliberation, Chancellor Tiemudie'er, wishing to secure his position and win favor, proposed installing Shidebala as crown prince; together with the empress dowager's favorite minister Shiliemen he slandered him before the two palaces; after long insinuation, the scheme succeeded.

units.zh: 延祐七年，仁宗崩，英宗嗣立。
units.en: Seventh year of Yanyou, Renzong died; Shidebala succeeded to the throne.
units.literal: Seventh year of YanYou, Renzong died; Shidebala succeeded to the throne.

units.zh: 帖古倫大皇后 右大斡耳朵 察必皇后 （弘吉列氏，魯忠武王按嗔那顏女也。中統初立為皇后，至元十年授冊寶，尋又上尊號曰貞懿昭順天睿文光應皇后。十八年崩，三十一年上尊諡曰昭睿順聖皇后。后性明敏，達於事機，至元之政，左右彌縫，當時以為蓋有力焉。） 南必皇后 （弘吉列氏。至元二十年納為皇后，時世祖春秋高，后頗預政，相臣常不得見帝，輒因后奏事焉。） 右第二斡耳朵 塔剌海皇后 奴罕皇后 右第三斡耳朵 伯要兀真皇后 闊闊倫皇后 右第四斡耳朵 八八罕妃子 右見歲賜錄，不知所守斡耳朵。 速哥答（思）里皇后 （泰定三年詔守世祖斡耳朵。） 撒不忽妃子
units.en: Great Empress Tegulün. Right Great Orda: Empress Chabi (Kongirat, daughter of the loyal and martial King Anchannayan of Lu; made empress at the start of the Zhongtong era, invested with seal and regalia in 1273, and soon given the honorific Empress Zhenyi Zhaoshun Tianrui Wenguang Ying; she died in 1281 and was posthumously titled Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng in 1294. Intelligent and politically astute, she was widely thought to have significantly shaped Zhiyuan-era governance). Empress Nanbi (Kongirat; taken as empress in 1283 when Kublai was elderly; she often intervened in government, and ministers who could not reach the emperor would report through her). Right Second Orda: Empress Talahai; Empress Nuhan. Right Third Orda: Empress Boyaowuzhen; Empress Kuokuolun. Right Fourth Orda: Consort Babuhan (listed in the annual grant register but with no orda recorded). Empress Sugedali (in 1326 ordered by edict to maintain Kublai's orda). Consort Sabuhu.
units.literal: Great Empress Tegulün. Right Great Orda: Empress Chabi (Kongirat clan, daughter of King Anchannayan of Lu, loyal and martial; established as empress at the beginning of Zhongtong; in the tenth year of Zhiyuan invested with seal and treasure; soon after elevated with honorific title Empress Zhenyi Zhaoshun Tianrui Wenguang Ying; died in the eighteenth year; in the thirty-first year honored with posthumous title Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng. The empress was intelligent and clear, adept at affairs; in the governance of Zhiyuan she mediated left and right—contemporaries thought she surely had great force). Empress Nanbi (Kongirat clan; in the twentieth year of Zhiyuan taken in as empress; at that time Shizu was advanced in years and the empress often participated in government; chief ministers frequently could not see the emperor and would present affairs through the empress). Right Second Orda: Empress Talahai. Empress Nuhan. Right Third Orda: Empress Boyaowuzhen. Empress Kuokuolun. Right Fourth Orda: Consort Babuhan. As seen in the record of annual grants, her orda guarded is unknown. Empress Sugedali (in the third year of Taiding an edict ordered her to guard Shizu's orda). Consort Sabuhu.

units.zh: 是時，御史中丞崔彧好盛氣待人，他御史拜謁，或平受之，獨見賡，則待以上客。
units.en: The censor-in-chief Cui Yu was overbearing toward his colleagues; when other censors called on him he often received them as equals, but he treated Geng as an honored guest.
units.literal: At the time the censor-in-chief Cui Yu liked to treat others with overbearing airs; when other censors came to pay respects he sometimes received them on equal terms, but when he saw Geng he treated him as an honored guest.

units.zh: 大德二年，升翰林直學士。
units.en: In the second year of Dade (1298) he was promoted direct academician of the Hanlin.
units.literal: In the second year of Dade he was promoted direct academician of the Hanlin.

units.zh: 答己妃子 （弘吉列氏。大德十一年尊為皇太后，延祐二年上尊號曰儀天興聖慈仁（明）昭懿壽元（合）全德泰寧福慶皇太后，七年又尊曰太皇太后，加徽文崇祐尊號。至治三年崩，諡曰昭獻元聖皇后。后性聰慧，然不事檢飭，及正位東朝，淫恣益甚，內則黑驢母亦列失八用事，外則幸臣失列門、紐鄰等及時宰迭木帖兒怙寵作非，濁亂朝政。及英宗立，羣倖誅，而後勢燄少熄焉。）
units.en: Consort Daji (Kongirat; honored as Empress Dowager in 1307; in 1315 given the lengthy honorific Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing; raised to Grand Empress Dowager in 1320 with the added epithet Weiwen Chongyou; died in 1322 and was posthumously titled Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng). She was clever but unrestrained; once established in the Eastern Palace her excesses deepened. Within the palace the "Black Donkey Mother" Yilieshiba dominated affairs; outside, favorites such as Shiliemen and Niulin, together with chief minister Tiemudier, abused imperial favor and corrupted government. After Gegeen acceded, this whole clique was executed and her influence waned.
units.literal: Consort Daji (Kongirat clan; in the eleventh year of Dade honored as Empress Dowager; in the second year of Yanyou elevated with honorific title Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing; in the seventh year again honored as Grand Empress Dowager, with added honorific Weiwen Chongyou; died in the third year of Zhizhi, posthumous title Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng. The consort was intelligent, yet did not restrain herself; when she took the eastern court as her proper position, licentious indulgence grew worse; within, the Black Donkey Mother Yilieshiba held power; without, favored ministers Shiliemen, Niulin, and others together with the chief minister at the time Tiemudier relied on favor to do wrong and muddied court government. When Yingzong was established, the whole group of favorites was executed, and thereafter her blaze of power slightly subsided).

units.zh: 明宗翼獻景孝皇帝，諱和世㻋，武宗長子也。
units.en: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Khoshila, was Wuzong's eldest son.
units.literal: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Khoshila, was Wuzong's eldest son.

units.zh: 十二月乙巳，知樞密院事臣也不倫等議請上尊謚曰翼獻景孝皇帝，廟號明宗。
units.en: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Yebulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Yebulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.

units.zh: 於是封帝為周王，出鎮雲南。
units.en: Thereupon he was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and sent out to garrison Yunnan.
units.literal: Thereupon he was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and sent out to garrison Yunnan.

units.zh: 復矯稱帝所遣使者自北方來，雲周王從諸王兵整駕南轅，旦夕即至矣。
units.en: He further falsely claimed that envoys dispatched by him had come from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling the princes' troops and turning the chariot south — he would arrive within the day.
units.literal: He further falsely claimed that envoys dispatched by him had come from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling the princes' troops and turning the chariot south — he would arrive within the day.

units.zh: 丙戌，帝即位於和寧之北，扈行諸王、大臣咸入賀，乃命撒迪遣人還報京師。
units.en: On bingxu day the Emperor ascended the throne north of Helin; the escorting princes and great ministers all entered to congratulate; he thereupon ordered Sadi to dispatch men back to report to the capital.
units.literal: On bingxu day the Emperor ascended the throne north of Helin; the escorting princes and great ministers all entered to congratulate; he thereupon ordered Sadi to dispatch men back to report to the capital.

units.zh: 庚寅，帝暴崩，年三十，葬起輦谷，從諸陵。
units.en: On gengyin day the Emperor died suddenly; he was 30 years old and was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
units.literal: On gengyin day the Emperor died suddenly; he was thirty years old and was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

units.zh: 二年，帝弟圖帖睦爾以懷王出居於建康。
units.en: Second year, his younger brother Tugh Temür went out to reside at Jiankang as Prince of Huai.
units.literal: Second year, his younger brother Tugh Temür went out to reside at Jiankang as Prince of Huai.

units.zh: 是歲夏四月丙寅，子妥歡帖木爾生，是為至正帝。
units.en: That year, summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, his son Toghan Temür was born — he who would become Emperor Zhizheng.
units.literal: That year, summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, his son Toghan Temür was born — he who would become Emperor Zhizheng.

units.zh: 三年三月癸酉，子懿璘質班生，是為寧宗。
units.en: Third year, third month, on guiyou day, his son Yilianzhen Shiraban was born — he who would become Emperor Ningzong.
units.literal: Third year, third month, on guiyou day, his son Yilianzhen Shiraban was born — he who would become Emperor Ningzong.

units.zh: 成宗大德三年，命武宗撫軍北邊，帝以四年十一月壬子生。
units.en: In the third year of Dade under Chengzong, Wuzong was ordered to command troops on the northern frontier; he was born on renzi day in the eleventh month of the fourth year.
units.literal: In the third year of Dade under Chengzong, Wuzong was ordered to command troops on the northern frontier; he was born on renzi day in the eleventh month of the fourth year.

units.zh: 遣撒迪等還京師，帝命之曰：「朕弟曩嘗覽觀書史，邇者得無廢乎？
units.en: He dispatched Sadi and the others back to the capital; the Emperor charged them, saying, "My younger brother once perused books and histories — has he lately neglected them?
units.literal: He dispatched Sadi and the others back to the capital; the Emperor charged them, saying, "My younger brother once perused books and histories — has he lately neglected them?

units.zh: 聽政之暇，宜親賢士大夫，講論史籍，以知古今治亂得失。
units.en: In the leisure of hearing government, he should draw near worthy scholar-officials and discuss historical records, to know the gains and losses of governance through the ages.
units.literal: In the leisure of hearing government, he should draw near worthy scholar-officials and discuss historical records, to know the gains and losses of governance through the ages.

units.zh: 卿等至京師，當以朕意諭之。」
units.en: When you reach the capital, you should convey my intent to him."
units.literal: When you reach the capital, you should convey my intent to him."

units.zh: 丙寅，帝謂中書左丞躍裏帖木兒曰：「朕至上都，宗藩諸王必皆來會，非尋常朝會比也，諸王察阿臺今亦從朕遠來，有司供張，皆宜豫備。
units.en: On bingyin day the Emperor said to central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür, "When I reach Shangdu, the princes of the imperial domains will surely all come to assemble — this is not comparable to an ordinary court audience; Prince Cha'atai now also follows me from afar; the relevant offices' provisions for guests must all be prepared in advance.
units.literal: On bingyin day the Emperor said to central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür, "When I reach Shangdu, the princes of the imperial domains will surely all come to assemble — this is not comparable to an ordinary court audience; Prince Cha'atai now also follows me from afar; the relevant offices' provisions for guests must all be prepared in advance.

units.zh: 卿其與中書臣僚議之。」
units.en: You should deliberate on this with the secretariat ministers."
units.literal: You should deliberate on this with the secretariat ministers."

units.zh: 帝特命臺臣曰：「太祖皇帝嘗訓敕臣下云：『美色、名馬，人皆悅之，然方寸一有系累，即能壞名敗德。』
units.en: The Emperor specially charged the censorate officials, saying, "Taizu once admonished his ministers, saying, 'Beautiful women and famous horses — all men delight in them; yet if the heart's inch is once entangled, it can ruin name and virtue.'
units.literal: The Emperor specially charged the censorate officials, saying, "Taizu once admonished his ministers, saying, 'Beautiful women and famous horses — all men delight in them; yet if the heart's inch is once entangled, it can ruin name and virtue.'

units.zh: 卿等居風紀之司，亦嘗念及此乎？
units.en: You who hold the office of wind and discipline — have you also ever borne this in mind?
units.literal: You who hold the office of wind and discipline — have you also ever borne this in mind?

units.zh: 世祖初立御史臺，首命塔察兒、奔帖傑兒二人協司其政。
units.en: When Shizu first established the Censorate, he first appointed Taqachar and Bentejir to jointly administer its affairs.
units.literal: When Shizu first established the Censorate, he first appointed Taqachar and Bentejir to jointly administer its affairs.

units.zh: 天下國家，譬猶一人之身，中書則右手也，樞密則左手也。
units.en: All under Heaven and the state are like a single person's body — the Secretariat is the right hand, the Privy Council the left hand.
units.literal: All under Heaven and the state are like a single person's body — the Secretariat is the right hand, the Privy Council the left hand.

units.zh: 左右手有病，治之以良醫，省、院闕失，不以御史臺治之可乎？
units.en: When the left and right hands are ill, one treats them with a good physician — when the Secretariat and Privy Council have faults and omissions, can one fail to treat them through the Censorate?
units.literal: When the left and right hands are ill, one treats them with a good physician — when the Secretariat and Privy Council have faults and omissions, can one fail to treat them through the Censorate?

units.zh: 凡諸王、百司，違法越禮，一聽舉劾。
units.en: For all princes and the hundred offices, whoever violates law or oversteps ritual — all alike are to be impeached.
units.literal: For all princes and the hundred offices, whoever violates law or oversteps ritual — all alike are to be impeached.

units.zh: 風紀重則貪墨懼，猶斧斤重則入木深，其勢然也。
units.en: When wind and discipline are weighty, the greedy and corrupt will fear — as when the axe is heavy, it enters the wood deeply; such is the force of it.
units.literal: When wind and discipline are weighty, the greedy and corrupt will fear — as when the axe is heavy, it enters the wood deeply; such is the force of it.

units.zh: 朕有闕失，卿亦以聞，朕不爾責也。」
units.en: If I have faults and omissions, you too should report them — I shall not blame you for it."
units.literal: If I have faults and omissions, you too should report them — I shall not blame you for it."

units.zh: 帝諭闊兒吉思等曰：「修德應天，乃君臣當為之事，鐵木兒補化所言良是。
units.en: The Emperor instructed Kuorugusi and others: "Cultivating virtue to respond to Heaven is what ruler and ministers ought to do; what Temur Buqa said is indeed right.
units.literal: The Emperor instructed Kuorugusi and others: "Cultivating virtue to respond to Heaven is what ruler and ministers ought to do; what Temur Buqa said is indeed right.

units.zh: 天明可畏，朕未嘗斯須忘於懷也。
units.en: Heaven's clarity is to be feared; We have never for an instant forgotten this in Our heart.
units.literal: Heaven's clarity is to be feared; We have never for an instant forgotten this in Our heart.

units.zh: 皇太子來會，當與共圖其可以澤民利物者行之。
units.en: When the crown prince comes to meet Us, We should together plan what can benefit the people and bring them material good, and put it into practice.
units.literal: When the crown prince comes to meet Us, We should together plan what can benefit the people and bring them material good, and put it into practice.

units.zh: 卿等其以朕意諭群臣。」
units.en: You should convey Our meaning to the hundred officials."
units.literal: You should convey Our meaning to the hundred officials."

units.zh: 乙未，特命孛羅等傳旨，宣諭燕鐵木兒、伯答沙、火沙、哈八兒禿、八即剌等曰：「世祖皇帝立中書省、樞密院、御史臺及百司庶府，共治天下，大小職掌，已有定制。
units.en: On yimao day Boluo and others were specially charged to transmit the intent and proclaim to Yan Temür, Badashah, Huosha, Qabarqu, Ba'irq, and others, saying, "Shizu established the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, the Censorate, and the hundred offices and various bureaus to jointly govern all under Heaven; great and small duties already have fixed regulations.
units.literal: On yimao day Boluo and others were specially charged to transmit the intent and proclaim to Yan Temür, Badashah, Huosha, Qabarqu, Ba'irq, and others, saying, "Shizu established the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, the Censorate, and the hundred offices and various bureaus to jointly govern all under Heaven; great and small duties already have fixed regulations.

units.zh: 世祖命廷臣集律令章程，以為萬世法。
units.en: Shizu ordered court ministers to compile statutes and regulations as law for ten thousand generations.
units.literal: Shizu ordered court ministers to compile statutes and regulations as law for ten thousand generations.

units.zh: 成宗以來，列聖相承，罔不恪遵成憲。
units.en: From Chengzong onward, successive sage emperors have none failed to reverently observe the established constitution.
units.literal: From Chengzong onward, successive sage emperors have none failed to reverently observe the established constitution.

units.zh: 朕今居太祖、世祖所居之位，凡省、院、臺、百司庶政，詢謀僉同，摽譯所奏，以告於朕。
units.en: I now occupy the seat where Taizu and Shizu dwelt; for all Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and hundred-office affairs, after consultation and unanimous deliberation, translate what is memorialized and report it to me.
units.literal: I now occupy the seat where Taizu and Shizu dwelt; for all Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and hundred-office affairs, after consultation and unanimous deliberation, translate what is memorialized and report it to me.

units.zh: 軍務機密，樞密院當即以聞，毋以夙夜為間而稽留之。
units.en: Military affairs of secrecy — the Privy Council should report them immediately; do not delay on account of early or late hour.
units.literal: Military affairs of secrecy — the Privy Council should report them immediately; do not delay on account of early or late hour.

units.zh: 其他事務，果有所言，必先中書、院、臺，其下百司及纮禦之臣，毋得隔越陳請。
units.en: For other affairs, if there is truly something to say, one must first go through the Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate; subordinate hundred offices and ministers of the broad defense must not overstep ranks in submitting requests.
units.literal: For other affairs, if there is truly something to say, one must first go through the Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate; subordinate hundred offices and ministers of the broad defense must not overstep ranks in submitting requests.

units.zh: 宜宣諭諸司，咸俾聞知。
units.en: This should be proclaimed to the various offices, so that all may hear and know.

units.zh: 四月癸巳，燕鐵木兒見帝於行在，率百官上皇帝寶，帝嘉其勛，拜太師，仍命為中書右丞相，開府儀同三司、上柱國、錄軍國重事、監修國史、答剌罕、太平王並如故。
units.en: Fourth month, on guisi day Yan Temür saw the Emperor at the traveling palace and led the hundred officials in presenting the imperial seal; the Emperor praised his merit and made him grand preceptor, still appointing him central secretariat right chancellor, commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, supervisor of the state history, darughachi, and Prince of Taiping — all as before.

units.zh: 於是帝方遠在沙漠，猝未能至，慮生他變，乃迎帝弟懷王於江陵，且宣言已遣使北迎帝，以安眾心。
units.en: At that time he was still far away in the desert and could not arrive suddenly; fearing other changes might arise, Yan Temür welcomed his younger brother the Prince of Huai at Jiangling and also proclaimed that envoys had already been dispatched north to welcome him, to reassure the multitude.

units.zh: 已而塔察兒、脫歡襲殺阿思罕、教化於河中，帝遂西行，至北邊金山。
units.en: Before long Taqachar and Tughon launched a surprise attack and killed Ashan and Jiaohua at Hezhong; he then went west and reached the Golden Mountain on the northern frontier.

units.zh: 帝至其部，與定約束，每歲冬居紥顏，夏居斡羅斡察山，春則命從者耕於野泥，十餘年間，邊境寧謐。
units.en: When he reached their territory, he fixed regulations with them: each year they wintered at Jaya'an, summered at Olokoch'a Mountain, and in spring ordered their followers to farm at Yeni; for more than 10 years the frontier was tranquil.

units.zh: 卜魯罕皇后 （伯岳吾氏，勳臣普化之孫，駙馬脫里忽思之女。元貞初立為皇后，大德三年授冊寶。十一年帝崩，武宗立，廢后，徙東安州，尋賜死。成宗晚年多疾，后居中用事，而能信任相臣哈剌哈孫，以卒成大德之治，識者猶有取焉。） 失憐答里元妃 （弘吉列氏，早薨。至大元年追尊諡曰貞慈靜懿皇后，配享成廟。） 乞里吉忽帖尼皇后
units.en: Empress Buluhan (Baiyuewu, granddaughter of the meritorious minister Puhua and daughter of the imperial son-in-law Telihusi; made empress at the start of Yuanzhen and invested in 1299; when Temür died in 1307 Külüg deposed her, exiled her to Dong'an, and soon had her executed. Though she dominated the inner court during Temür's late illnesses, she trusted the chief minister Harqasun and helped bring the Dade reign to a stable close—a point critics still acknowledged). Primary Consort Shilian Dali (Kongirat; died young; posthumously titled Empress Zhenci Jingyi in 1308 and enshrined at Chengzong's temple). Empress Qilijihutieni.
units.literal: Empress Buluhan (Baiyuewu clan, granddaughter of meritorious minister Puhua, daughter of consort Telihusi; established as empress at the beginning of Yuanzhen; in the third year of Dade invested with seal and treasure; in the eleventh year the emperor died, Wuzong was established, the empress was deposed, moved to Dong'an Prefecture, and soon ordered to die by grant. In Chengzong's later years he had many illnesses; the empress held power within the palace yet was able to trust chief minister Harqasun, thereby completing the governance of Dade—those of discernment still found something to approve). Primary Consort Shilian Dali (Kongirat clan, early death; in the first year of Zhida posthumously honored with title Empress Zhenci Jingyi, enshrined with Chengzong's temple). Empress Qilijihutieni.
